evidence.quote: neither he nor Hay was better off in any other respect, and their chief title to consideration was their right to look out of their windows
He was amply satisfied with their consideration; but their chief title to consideration was their right to look out of their windows on great men

adjudications.reason: In the revision, the clause that makes Hay and Adams the subject has been cut, along with Hay's book paragraph. The nearest plural antecedent for 'their chief title… their windows' is now the three readers, so the window privilege attaches to the wrong people. Restoring the source clause fixes the referent and restores the irony that the authors' only distinction is their address.

evidence.quote: then also insisted on going out
until, in 1892, none of them held any post at all

adjudications.reason: Paragraph 14 explains King's resignation but drops Hay's, yet it states that none of the three held any post. Paragraph 8's 'stayed there' leaves Hay seemingly still Assistant Secretary. A short source clause restoring that Hay also went out fixes the gap. His purpose (Lincoln) is already given in paragraph 8, so it need not be repeated.

evidence.quote: The interest of the figure was not in its meaning, but in the response of the observer.

adjudications.reason: The function survives in the revision. Adams's assumption of the meaning is stated outright ('He supposed its meaning to be the one commonplace'), and the pivot to observers is kept ('The interest of the figure was not in its meaning, but in the response of the observer'). The mirror principle remains intact. The cut is a legitimate compression under word pressure.

evidence.quote: the Teutonic was a marvel. That he should be able to eat his dinner through a week of howling winter gales was a miracle. Wonder may be double--even treble.

adjudications.reason: Two wonders still precede 'double--even treble': the Teutonic as 'a marvel' and the dinner 'miracle'. The protected Niagara ratio is intact. Restoring a 27-word sentence would break the word budget for a matter of rhythm only.

remaining_concerns: The estimated net change is about +7 words (to roughly 3301); code should confirm the count.
